name: Uncertainty
overview: Scripture teaches that in the midst of uncertainty, believers are called to place their full trust in the Lord rather than their own understanding, relying on His sustaining power and faithfulness. God promises to uphold and strengthen His people, guarding their steps and providing peace amid fear and doubt. Rather than being anxious about life's needs, believers are encouraged to cast their burdens upon the Lord, confident that He has good plans and will never allow the righteous to be moved or forsaken.
